  <div id="deployGuideModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-3xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl border border-slate-200">
      <div class="sticky top-0 bg-slate-900 text-white px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between z-10">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-globe text-gold-400 text-lg"></i>
          <span class="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base">Panduan Hosting Gratis & Terbaca di Google Search</span>
        </div>
        <button id="closeDeployGuideBtn" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-5 text-sm text-slate-700">
        <div class="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl p-4 text-emerald-900 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          <strong>Siap Pakai 100%:</strong> File website ini sudah mandiri (lengkap dengan foto, kalkulator KPR, form titip jual, dan panel admin). Anda cukup mengunggah 1 file ini ke penyedia hosting gratis di bawah ini.
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-4">
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
            <h3 class="font-extrabold text-slate-900 text-base mb-1">Langkah 1: Unduh File Website & Ubah Nama Menjadi <code class="bg-slate-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">index.html</code></h3>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600">Simpan file website ini ke komputer Anda, lalu ubah namanya menjadi <code>index.html</code> agar otomatis dikenali sebagai halaman utama.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
            <h3 class="font-extrabold text-slate-900 text-base mb-1">Langkah 2: Upload ke Hosting & Subdomain Gratis (Tanpa Biaya Bulanan)</h3>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 mt-2">
              <li><strong>Opsi A — Netlify Drop (Paling Cepat, 1 Menit):</strong> Buka <a href="https://app.netlify.com/signup" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-brand-700 font-bold underline">Netlify</a>, daftar akun gratis, lalu tarik folder berisi file <code>index.html</code> ke halaman dashboard. Anda langsung mendapat alamat gratis seperti <code>griya-harmoni.netlify.app</code>.</li>
              <li><strong>Opsi B — GitHub Pages:</strong> Buat akun di <a href="https://pages.github.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-brand-700 font-bold underline">GitHub Pages</a>, buat repository baru, unggah <code>index.html</code>, lalu aktifkan menu <em>Settings &rarr; Pages</em> untuk memperoleh domain <code>namaperumahan.github.io</code>.</li>
              <li><strong>Opsi C — Vercel:</strong> Daftar gratis di <a href="https://vercel.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-brand-700 font-bold underline">Vercel</a> untuk mendapatkan domain <code>namaperumahan.vercel.app</code> dengan SSL (HTTPS) otomatis.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
            <h3 class="font-extrabold text-slate-900 text-base mb-1">Langkah 3: Daftarkan ke Google Search Console Agar Terbaca di Google</h3>
            <ol class="list-decimal list-inside space-y-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 mt-2">
              <li>Buka layanan resmi gratis <a href="https://search.google.com/search-console/about" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-brand-700 font-bold underline">Google Search Console</a> dan login dengan akun Gmail Anda.</li>
              <li>Pilih kolom <strong>URL Prefix</strong> lalu masukkan alamat website gratis Anda (contoh: <code>https://griya-harmoni.netlify.app</code>).</li>
              <li>Lakukan verifikasi kepemilikan (bisa melalui tag HTML atau file verifikasi), lalu klik menu <strong>Inspeksi URL (URL Inspection) &rarr; Minta Pengindeksan (Request Indexing)</strong>.</li>
              <li>Tambahkan juga titik lokasi perumahan Anda di <strong>Google Business Profile (Google Maps)</strong> dan cantumkan link website tersebut agar muncul di halaman pertama pencarian lokal.</li>
            </ol>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

      // 2. HERO SLIDER LOGIC
      let currentSlideIndex = 0;
      let slideTimer = null;

      function renderHeroSlider() {
        const container = document.getElementById("heroSlidesContainer");
        const dots = document.getElementById("heroDotsContainer");
        container.innerHTML = "";
        dots.innerHTML = "";

        appState.slides.forEach((slide, idx) => {
          const activeClass = idx === currentSlideIndex ? "opacity-100 z-10" : "opacity-0 z-0 pointer-events-none";
          const slideEl = document.createElement("div");
          slideEl.className = `hero-slide absolute inset-0 ${activeClass}`;
          slideEl.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${slide.image}" alt="${slide.title}" class="w-full h-full object-cover object-center" />
            <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/70 to-slate-900/30"></div>
            <div class="absolute inset-0 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex flex-col justify-center">
              <div class="max-w-2xl space-y-4">
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-gold-500 text-slate-950 text-xs font-extrabold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider shadow">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i> ${slide.badge}
                </span>
                <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold text-white leading-tight">${slide.title}</h1>
                <p class="text-slate-200 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed">${slide.subtitle}</p>
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 pt-2">
                  <button data-slide-target="${slide.targetNav}" class="slide-cta-btn px-5 py-3 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-500 text-white font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg transition flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>${slide.ctaText}</span> <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
                  </button>
                  <button data-slide-wa="${slide.title}" class="slide-wa-btn px-5 py-3 rounded-xl bg-white/15 hover:bg-white/25 text-white backdrop-blur-md font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm border border-white/25 transition flex items-center gap-2">
                    <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-emerald-400 text-base"></i> Tanya Promo Ini via WA
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
          container.appendChild(slideEl);

          const dotBtn = document.createElement("button");
          dotBtn.className = idx === currentSlideIndex
            ? "w-8 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-gold-400 transition-all"
            : "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/50 hover:bg-white transition-all";
          dotBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pilih Slide " + (idx + 1));
          dotBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            currentSlideIndex = idx;
            renderHeroSlider();
            restartSlideTimer();
          });
          dots.appendChild(dotBtn);
        });

        container.querySelectorAll(".slide-cta-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const target = btn.getAttribute("data-slide-target");
            scrollToSection(target);
          });
        });

        container.querySelectorAll(".slide-wa-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const title = btn.getAttribute("data-slide-wa");
            openWhatsApp(`Halo Admin ${appState.brandName}, saya tertarik dengan promo banner "${title}". Mohon info lengkapnya.`);
          });
        });
      }

      function restartSlideTimer() {
        if (slideTimer) clearInterval(slideTimer);
        slideTimer = setInterval(() => {
          currentSlideIndex = (currentSlideIndex + 1) % appState.slides.length;
          renderHeroSlider();
        }, 6000);
      }

      document.getElementById("prevSlideBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
        currentSlideIndex = (currentSlideIndex - 1 + appState.slides.length) % appState.slides.length;
        renderHeroSlider();
        restartSlideTimer();
      });

      document.getElementById("nextSlideBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
        currentSlideIndex = (currentSlideIndex + 1) % appState.slides.length;
        renderHeroSlider();
        restartSlideTimer();
      });

      // 3. RENDER PROPERTY CATALOG & FILTER
      let activeCategory = "ALL";
      let searchKeyword = "";

      function renderCatalog() {
        const grid = document.getElementById("propertiesGrid");
        const approvedList = appState.properties.filter(p => p.status === "approved");

        // Update category counts
        document.getElementById("countALL").textContent = approvedList.length;
        document.getElementById("countSubsidi").textContent = approvedList.filter(p => p.category === "Subsidi").length;
        document.getElementById("countKomersil").textContent = approvedList.filter(p => p.category === "Komersil").length;
        document.getElementById("countKios").textContent = approvedList.filter(p => p.category === "Kios").length;
        document.getElementById("countTitip").textContent = approvedList.filter(p => p.category === "Titip Jual").length;

        const filtered = approvedList.filter(item => {
          const matchCat = activeCategory === "ALL" || item.category === activeCategory;
          const kw = searchKeyword.toLowerCase();
          const matchKw = !kw || item.title.toLowerCase().includes(kw) || item.location.toLowerCase().includes(kw) || item.specs.toLowerCase().includes(kw);
          return matchCat && matchKw;
        });

        grid.innerHTML = "";
        if (filtered.length === 0) {
          grid.innerHTML = `
            <div class="col-span-full bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 text-center border border-slate-200">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-house-circle-xmark text-3xl text-slate-400 mb-2"></i>
              <div class="font-bold text-slate-800">Tidak ada unit yang cocok dengan pencarian Anda.</div>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Silakan pilih kategori lain atau reset kata kunci pencarian.</p>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        filtered.forEach(item => {
          let badgeColor = "bg-emerald-600 text-white";
          if (item.category === "Komersil") badgeColor = "bg-blue-600 text-white";
          if (item.category === "Kios") badgeColor = "bg-amber-600 text-white";
          if (item.category === "Titip Jual") badgeColor = "bg-purple-700 text-white";

          const card = document.createElement("article");
          card.className = "bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-slate-200 flex flex-col justify-between transition group";
          card.innerHTML = `
            <div>
              <div class="relative aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden bg-slate-100">
                <img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.title}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-500" />
                <span class="absolute top-3 left-3 ${badgeColor} text-xs font-extrabold px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow">
                  ${item.category}
                </span>
                <span class="absolute bottom-3 right-3 bg-slate-950/85 text-gold-400 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-tag mr-1"></i> ${item.promo}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div class="p-5">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 mb-1">
                  <span><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot text-brand-600 mr-1"></i> ${item.location}</span>
                  <span class="font-semibold text-slate-700">${item.legal}</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="font-extrabold text-slate-900 text-base sm:text-lg leading-snug mb-2">${item.title}</h3>
                <div class="text-xl font-extrabold text-brand-700 mb-3">${formatRupiah(item.price)}</div>
                <div class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-ruler-combined text-brand-600 mr-1.5"></i> ${item.specs}
                </div>
                <p class="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">${item.description}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="px-5 pb-5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <button data-sim-id="${item.id}" class="sim-unit-btn py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-calculator text-brand-700"></i> Hitung Cicilan
                </button>
                <button data-wa-id="${item.id}" class="wa-unit-btn py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition">
                  <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-sm"></i> Tanya Unit
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
          grid.appendChild(card);
        });

        grid.querySelectorAll(".sim-unit-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const id = btn.getAttribute("data-sim-id");
            const prop = appState.properties.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (prop) {
              document.getElementById("kprSelectUnit").value = prop.id;
              applyPropertyToKpr(prop);
              scrollToSection("kpr");
            }
          });
        });

        grid.querySelectorAll(".wa-unit-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const id = btn.getAttribute("data-wa-id");
            const prop = appState.properties.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (prop) {
              openWhatsApp(`Halo Admin ${appState.brandName}, saya berminat dengan unit *${prop.title}* (${prop.category}) harga ${formatRupiah(prop.price)}. Apakah stok kavlingnya masih tersedia?`);
            }
          });
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll(".cat-filter-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          activeCategory = btn.getAttribute("data-cat");
          document.querySelectorAll(".cat-filter-btn").forEach(b => {
            b.className = "cat-filter-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 transition";

      document.getElementById("searchPropertyInput").addEventListener("input", e => {
        searchKeyword = e.target.value;
        renderCatalog();
      });

      // 4. INTERACTIVE VIDEO WALKTHROUGH PLAYER (CANVAS)
      const tourCanvas = document.getElementById("propertyTourCanvas");
      const tourCtx = tourCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const loadedTourImages = {};
      let activeTourMode = "subsidi";
      let isVideoPlaying = true;
      let videoTick = 0;

      const TOUR_CONFIG = {
        subsidi: {
          src: SUBSIDI_IMG,
          label: "VIDEO WALKTHROUGH: RUMAH SUBSIDI TIPE 36/60",
          caption: "Menampilkan: Fasad Minimalis, Carport Mobil, Taman Depan & Jalan Lingkungan 8 Meter.",
          specsOverlay: ["KPR Subsidi Bunga 5% Flat", "2 Kamar Tidur + 1 Kamar Mandi", "Rangka Atap Baja Ringan SNI"]
        },
        komersil: {
          src: KOMERSIL_IMG,
          label: "VIDEO WALKTHROUGH: VILLA KOMERSIL 2 LANTAI TIPE 65/90",
          caption: "Menampilkan: Balkon Kaca Tempered, Fasad Batu Alam, 3 Kamar Tidur & One Gate Security.",
          specsOverlay: ["Cluster One Gate System & CCTV", "Lantai Granit 60x60 Full", "Bonus Kanopi & Smart Door Lock"]
        },
        kios: {
          src: KIOS_IMG,
          label: "VIDEO WALKTHROUGH: KIOS & RUKO NIAGA BOULEVARD",
          caption: "Menampilkan: Deretan Ruko & Kios Hadap Jalan Utama dengan Area Parkir Bersama Luas.",
          specsOverlay: ["Lokasi Tepat di Gerbang Utama", "Target Pasar Ratusan KK Penghuni", "Cocok untuk Minimarket, Kuliner & Apotek"]
        }
      };

      function preloadTourImages() {
        Object.keys(TOUR_CONFIG).forEach(key => {
          const img = new Image();
          img.src = TOUR_CONFIG[key].src;
          loadedTourImages[key] = img;
        });
      }

      function renderVideoFrame() {
        const width = (tourCanvas.width = 800);
        const height = (tourCanvas.height = 450);
        const cfg = TOUR_CONFIG[activeTourMode];
        const img = loadedTourImages[activeTourMode];

        tourCtx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
        tourCtx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        if (img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
          // Smooth pan and zoom effect (Ken Burns drone camera simulation)
          const cycle = (Math.sin(videoTick * 0.012) + 1) / 2;
          const scale = 1.04 + cycle * 0.12;
          const sw = width / scale;
          const sh = height / scale;
          const sx = (width - sw) * cycle;
          const sy = (height - sh) * (1 - cycle * 0.5);

          tourCtx.save();
          tourCtx.translate(width / 2, height / 2);
          tourCtx.scale(scale, scale);
          tourCtx.translate(-width / 2 + (cycle - 0.5) * 30, -height / 2 + (0.5 - cycle) * 15);
          tourCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
          tourCtx.restore();
        }

        // Lower third broadcast graphic bar
        const grad = tourCtx.createLinearGradient(0, height - 110, 0, height);
        grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(2, 6, 23, 0)");
        grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.9)");
        tourCtx.fillStyle = grad;
        tourCtx.fillRect(0, height - 110, width, 110);

        const highlightIdx = Math.floor(videoTick / 90) % cfg.specsOverlay.length;
        tourCtx.fillStyle = "#10b981";
        tourCtx.fillRect(24, height - 58, 6, 36);

        tourCtx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
        tourCtx.font = "bold 13px Inter, sans-serif";
        tourCtx.fillText("FITUR UNGGULAN UNIT:", 40, height - 42);

        tourCtx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
        tourCtx.font = "bold 18px Inter, sans-serif";
        tourCtx.fillText(cfg.specsOverlay[highlightIdx], 40, height - 20);

        // Progress bar at bottom
        const progress = (videoTick % 450) / 450;
        tourCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
        tourCtx.fillRect(0, height - 5, width, 5);
        tourCtx.fillStyle = "#10b981";
        tourCtx.fillRect(0, height - 5, width * progress, 5);

        if (isVideoPlaying) {
          videoTick++;
          const sec = Math.floor((videoTick % 450) / 10);
          document.getElementById("videoTimeCounter").textContent =
            "00:" + String(sec).padStart(2, "0") + " / 00:45";
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(renderVideoFrame);
      }

      function toggleVideoPlayback() {
        isVideoPlaying = !isVideoPlaying;
        const icon = document.getElementById("toggleVideoPlayIcon");
        const text = document.getElementById("toggleVideoPlayText");
        const bubble = document.getElementById("playIconBubble");

      // 5. KPR CALCULATOR LOGIC
      function populateKprSelectDropdown() {
        const select = document.getElementById("kprSelectUnit");
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Unit atau Masukkan Harga Manual --</option>';
        appState.properties.filter(p => p.status === "approved").forEach(prop => {
          const opt = document.createElement("option");
          opt.value = prop.id;
          opt.textContent = `${prop.title} — ${formatRupiah(prop.price)}`;
          select.appendChild(opt);
        });
      }

      function applyPropertyToKpr(prop) {
        document.getElementById("kprPriceInput").value = prop.price;
        if (prop.category === "Subsidi") {
          document.getElementById("kprDpPercentInput").value = 5;
          document.getElementById("kprRateInput").value = 5.0;
          document.getElementById("kprTenorInput").value = "15";
          document.getElementById("kprSchemeBadge").textContent = "Subsidi FLPP 5%";
        } else if (prop.category === "Kios") {
          document.getElementById("kprDpPercentInput").value = 15;
          document.getElementById("kprRateInput").value = 9.5;
          document.getElementById("kprTenorInput").value = "10";
          document.getElementById("kprSchemeBadge").textContent = "Kredit Niaga / Kios";
        } else {
          document.getElementById("kprDpPercentInput").value = 10;
          document.getElementById("kprRateInput").value = 8.5;
          document.getElementById("kprTenorInput").value = "15";
          document.getElementById("kprSchemeBadge").textContent = "KPR Komersil";
        }
        calculateKpr();
      }

      function calculateKpr() {
        const price = Math.max(0, Number(document.getElementById("kprPriceInput").value) || 0);
        const dpPercent = Number(document.getElementById("kprDpPercentInput").value) || 5;
        const annualRate = Number(document.getElementById("kprRateInput").value) || 5;
        const tenorYears = Number(document.getElementById("kprTenorInput").value) || 15;

        const dpAmount = Math.round(price * (dpPercent / 100));
        const principal = Math.max(0, price - dpAmount);
        const months = tenorYears * 12;
        const monthlyRate = annualRate / 100 / 12;

        let monthlyPayment = 0;
        if (monthlyRate > 0 && months > 0) {
          monthlyPayment = (principal * monthlyRate) / (1 - Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, -months));
        } else if (months > 0) {
          monthlyPayment = principal / months;
        }
        monthlyPayment = Math.round(monthlyPayment);
        const minIncome = Math.round(monthlyPayment * 3);

        document.getElementById("kprDpPercentLabel").textContent = dpPercent;
        document.getElementById("kprDpNominalDisplay").textContent = formatRupiah(dpAmount);
        document.getElementById("kprMonthlyResult").innerHTML = `${formatRupiah(monthlyPayment)} <span class="text-sm font-normal text-emerald-100">/ bln</span>`;
        document.getElementById("kprPrincipalResult").textContent = formatRupiah(principal);
        document.getElementById("kprDpResult").textContent = formatRupiah(dpAmount);
        document.getElementById("kprTenorRateResult").textContent = `${tenorYears} Thn (${annualRate}% / thn)`;
        document.getElementById("kprMinIncomeResult").textContent = `${formatRupiah(minIncome)} / bln`;
      }

      document.getElementById("kprSelectUnit").addEventListener("change", e => {
        const prop = appState.properties.find(p => p.id === e.target.value);
        if (prop) applyPropertyToKpr(prop);
      });

      ["kprPriceInput", "kprDpPercentInput", "kprRateInput", "kprTenorInput"].forEach(id => {
        document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("input", calculateKpr);
      });

      document.querySelectorAll(".kpr-preset-btn").forEach(btn => {

          btn.className = "kpr-preset-btn py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-brand-600 text-white shadow-sm transition";

          if (preset === "subsidi") {
            document.getElementById("kprPriceInput").value = 166000000;

      });

      // Global WhatsApp Triggers
      ["topWaBtn", "headerWaBtn", "floatingWaBtn"].forEach(id => {
        document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("click", () => {
          openWhatsApp(`Halo Admin ${appState.brandName}, saya mengunjungi website resmi Anda dan ingin berkonsultasi mengenai unit Perumahan Subsidi, Komersil, Kios, atau Titip Jual Properti.`);
        });
      });

      function renderAll() {
        renderHeaderAndBranding();
        renderHeroSlider();
        renderCatalog();
        populateKprSelectDropdown();
        calculateKpr();
        renderAdminPanel();
      }

      // Initialize App
      preloadTourImages();
      renderAll();
      restartSlideTimer();
      requestAnimationFrame(renderVideoFrame);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
